# PrimeBizValue

> PrimeBizValue.com produces fast, documented business valuations for owners of small and franchised businesses, priced at a fraction of a broker's opinion of value. Upload a P&L, get a free on-screen SDE/EBITDA recast in minutes; the Summary Report ($19.99) gives the estimated value range on one page, and the Custom ($199) and Prime Certified Opinion of Value ($799) reports add the documented recast, SBA financing analysis, and closing breakdown. Franchisors can join the Partner Program ($2,500 one-time) for a standing 30% discount for their franchisees.

## What it does

- Recasts a profit-and-loss statement into Seller's Discretionary Earnings (SDE) and Adjusted EBITDA using a documented, repeatable add-back worksheet.
- Applies a benchmark multiple from fixed Main Street SDE-size tiers, adjusted for earnings trend, risk, and upside factors.
- Runs an SBA 7(a) debt-service coverage (DSCR) check so the price is tested against what a lender will finance.
- Produces a closing cash-to-seller estimate after inventory, debt payoff, closing costs, broker fees, and capital gains.
- Offers franchisors a branded valuation page for their franchisees ($2,500 one-time setup, 30% off reports for every owner in the system).

## Definitions the site uses

- **SDE (Seller's Discretionary Earnings):** net profit plus owner salary, owner payroll taxes, depreciation, amortization, interest, and documented discretionary or one-time expenses. The standard earnings measure for owner-operated Main Street businesses.
- **Adjusted EBITDA:** SDE minus a market-rate replacement management salary. Used when the buyer will not operate the business.
- **DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio):** post-close cash flow divided by annual loan payments. SBA lenders typically want 1.25x or better.
- **Multiple tiers:** Main Street — Low (SDE under $75k, 0–1.5x), Typical ($75k–$250k, 1.6–3.4x), High ($250k–$2M, 3.4–4.0x), Top Tier ($2M+, 4.1–5.0x).

## What it is not

Not a certified appraisal, not a broker, not a lender, and not financial, legal, or tax advice. Reports state this plainly. Uploaded financials are retained only to produce and support the valuation and are not sold.
